projects.name: Project HIGHLIGHTS
details: Hyper Automation Solution – Power Apps + AI Builder + Power Automate:
- Developed a canvas Power App for users to upload various types of KYC documents.
- Built and integrated a document segregation AI Builder model triggered via Power Automate Cloud Flows. This
model classifies document types and routes them to appropriate AI Builder models trained on credit cards,
passports, employment contracts, pay slips, and more.
- The extracted data is stored in a CSV file, processed, and passed back to Power Apps for review and validation.
- Created supporting Power Automate Desktop flows that access third-party applications like Omiga, TransUnion,
and BMM to fetch customer verification data. This involved a maintenance module that resets application
credentials, a loader to queue volumes, and a worker module to collect and store outputs in a formatted MI
report.
- Output reports are distributed to business users for validation and decision-making.
Incident Management Tracker
- Built a Power App integrated with SharePoint to manage incident reports for RPA bots.
- The app captures details such as ticket ID, description, status, assigned team member, and comments.
- Notifications are sent via Outlook to inform users about ticket updates, enabling efficient tracking and resolution
of issues.
Automated Birthday Email Workflow
- Designed a Power Automate scheduled workflow that reads employee data from a SharePoint list to check for
birthdays.
- Automatically sends a personalized birthday greeting email to employees using Outlook integration.
Leave Approval Cloud Flow
- Automated leave approval using SharePoint triggers.
- Implemented manager approval logic with automated reminder emails for pending actions.
- Updated request status after approval/rejection and sent confirmation notifications to employees.
Automated Banking Applications – Power Automate Desktop (Migration)
- Migrated Blue Prism bots to Power Automate Desktop to interact with web-based banking systems.
- Automated data retrieval from Omiga, TransUnion, and HUB applications.
- Data was formatted and consolidated into master Excel files for monthly reporting, saving the business 20 FTEs.
Commercial Banking Assistant (Copilot Agent)
- Designed and implemented an intelligent Commercial Banking Assistant that responds to the underwriter queries
with provided knowledge sources. It provides information on financial analysis, Risk management, Credit
Structuring with useful documentation and training links.
Migration and Version Upgrade Projects – Blue Prism
- Upgraded Blue Prism from v6.10.3 to v6.10.5, enabling enhanced features and improved stability.
- Migrated bots from Internet Explorer to Microsoft Edge due to deprecation, solving multiple UI spying
challenges.
- Upgraded SAP from v750 to v770, re-spied SAP elements, aligned the layouts and configuration settings.
Blue Prism Bot Operations & Support
- Performed routine bot health checks, handled production issues, resolved exceptions, and implemented change
requests in line with SLAs.
- Documented technical workflows using Microsoft Visio for audit and knowledge transfer.
